items.title: Lesson Podcast
items.description: Audio guide to how everyday media use builds identity and the role of fandom in participatory culture.

items.title: Media Studies — Henry Jenkins Fandom Theory — Mrs Fisher
items.description: Clear GCSE guide to Jenkins' fandom theory — participatory culture and how fans actively engage with media texts.

items.title: Henry Jenkins on Participatory Culture — Edutopia
items.description: Jenkins himself explains participatory culture and how digital media transforms audiences into active producers of meaning.

items.title: The Social Network (2010)
items.description: The founding of Facebook as a story about how participatory platforms reshape identity and social life — directly linked to this lesson.

items.title: The Social Dilemma (2020)
items.description: Explores how platform design exploits fandom and identity needs — the dark side of participatory culture.

items.title: AQA GCSE Media Studies — Specification & Past Papers
items.description: Official AQA page with the full specification and past papers for GCSE Media Studies 8572.

items.title: The Fake Reality of Social Media — TEDxYouth
items.description: A teen's TEDx talk on how social media shapes self-identity and the pressure of curated fandom identities online.
